clue.text: Delivered around close once a week

indicators.note: one word wraps around the other, so it holds the second word inside it

parts.note: something delivered has been sent
close by, near at hand

explanation.surface: A parcel or newspaper dropped round to a nearby house every week.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Once' means formerly: SENNIGHT, 'seven nights', is an archaic word for a week.
explanation.definitionFit: Sennight is the old contraction of seven nights, a term for a seven-day period that has since dropped out of everyday use.

explanation.walkthrough: 'Leaders' is plural, so it takes two letters rather than one; the whole clue doubles as a description of a church split.
explanation.definitionFit: A schism is a formal split within a religious body, exactly the kind of rupture the surface describes.

clue.text: Butterflies trapped in inner vestibule
